Priya (PM): quick sync — we need to decide scope for the parallel/multi-step tool-chaining surface for the next milestone. customers asking for multiple concurrent tool calls + coordinated retries/timeouts.
Alex (Eng): +1. do we view this as an SDK-level orchestration or part of the platform API?
Priya (PM): platform API. sales wants a single request model so client can ask for multiple tool invocations and get back a consolidated structured result. lowers client complexity.
Maya (Design): important to define UX for partial success — how do we present partial outputs vs. overall failure?
Rajat (SRE): reliability concerns: parallel fanout increases burstiness. need clear SLOs, backpressure and capacity routing (dedicated vs hosted). also idempotency for retries.
Alex (Eng): propose two modes: "sequence" and "fanout". sequence = ordered steps, KV cache carried between steps. fanout = parallel independent calls. both support per-step timeouts + overall saga timeout.
Sam (Data): telemetry: we need token-level cost and per-step latency breakdowns for billing and regression alerts. add eval hooks so customers can attach prompt sets.
Priya (PM): launch criteria idea: 1) API contract for steps + ordering, 2) idempotent retry semantics documented, 3) console tracing per-step, 4) cost estimation preview, 5) 2 customers onboarded in beta. thoughts?
Alex (Eng): implementation notes: prefer single RPC with steps array. example request: ```json
POST /v1/tool_chains
{
  "mode": "fanout",
  "steps": [ {"name":"search","tool":"web_search","args":{}}, {"name":"ner","tool":"entity_extractor","args":{}} ],
  "idempotency_key": "req-abc-123",
  "timeouts": {"per_step_ms": 2000, "overall_ms": 8000},
  "retry": {"on": ["network_error"], "max_attempts": 2, "strategy": "failover"}
}
```
Maya (Design): UX question: should we return structured envelope: { steps: [{name, status, output, error}], overall_status } so client can render intermediate states?
Priya (PM): yes. structured envelope required. also add a streaming mode where steps stream as they complete.
Rajat (SRE): retries: we need two categories: idempotent-step retries (safe to re-run) and non-idempotent-step (external side effects). provide explicit step flag "side_effect": true|false. if side_effect:true then platform should not auto-retry, only surface failure.
Alex (Eng): agree. add a per-step header to mark "committable" and a hook for customers to provide compensating actions in a follow-up step.
Sam (Data): add an SDK helper to simulate cost and token counts before execution (dry-run). that will help with purchase decisions.
Priya (PM): prioritization: must-have for beta = ordering modes, structured envelope, per-step timeouts, idempotency_key, basic retries for idempotent steps, tracing in console. nice-to-have = streaming per-step, dry-run cost estimator, compensating-step primitives.
Maya (Design): acceptance criteria for UX: console shows timeline, per-step logs, clear failure reasons, CTA to retry single failed step.
Rajat (SRE): operational gating: ensure autoscaler can handle burst of N fanout calls. add queuing limit and early-429 behavior.
Alex (Eng): API contract detail: semantics for "ordering" field: "ordered" (execute sequentially, short-circuit on fatal error), "unordered" (execute concurrently, return all statuses), "map_reduce" (run many then aggregate). also need guidance for KV transfer size limits between steps.
Priya (PM): can we capture these in a one-pager and get eng + sres sign-off? I'll draft and assign owners.
Maya (Design): I'll mock console timeline and replay states by Friday.
Rajat (SRE): I'll run capacity sims for fanout=50, step_avg_latency=120ms. target SLOs and queuing thresholds will follow.
Alex (Eng): I'll spike the single-RPC proto and sketch the retry semantics. will add sample SDK pseudocode.
Sam (Data): I'll document telemetry dimensions we need and what the console should surface for regressions.
deploy-bot: pipelined deploy for "tool-chains-spike" succeeded in staging — build 2026.4.12.
Priya (PM): ok team — goal: define beta API + acceptance tests in 2 sprints. if anyone has major objections or missing items call them out now. :thumbsup:
Alex (Eng): :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): +1
Rajat (SRE): +1 will post sim results when ready
Sam (Data): +1
Priya (PM): thanks — I'll post the draft doc in #product.
